Guidance & outlook: As of now, luggage is around 50% to 60% of our business, but going ahead by '27, '28, we target to have any, any sector, not more than 30% of our business.
If we target only about India, we can see a very big market also, but we are not targeting India, we are targeting global, means around the globe.
And regarding the volume targets, we think this year we will, means next year we will have almost 20% of our business with these brands.
Growth & demand: The first half of FY26, the company delivered robust financial results highlighted by strong revenue growth and improved profit metrics compared to the same period last year.
Our revenue from operations rose sharply to INR107 crores, which is up 40.73% indicating strong demand.
Our PAT grew robustly by 26.77% to INR6.17 crores.
Margins & costs: Our EBITDA showed 45% year-on-year to INR10.86 crores with the EBITDA margin improving to 10.15% from 9.85% last year.
And my second question is, sir, I mean, there is substantial difference of 6% to 8% EBITDA margin in H1 versus H2.
Like EBITDA margins in H2 will be significantly higher by 7% to 8% in H2.
Capex & expansion: So weaving capacity right now, we have around 18 to 20 lakh meters.
So till what peak revenue you don't need to expand your own capacity and how much out of suppose you're earning suppose INR300 crores next year as an exam ple.
But right now, up to INR300 crores, I think we have the sufficient capacity with the contract manufacturing we are getting done outside.
Balance sheet & cash: We have not increased any means for that debt out there.
Yes, sir, I think there is some mistake debt is not going up.
Already, if you see from 31st March 2025 as on 30th September 2025, short-term borrowings also reduced and long-term borrowings also have reduced.
Risks & challenges: These statements are not the guarantee of future performance and involve risk and uncertainties that are difficult to predict.
